	lotEventInfo = dict(self.view.custom.lotEventInfo)
	
	if len(payload['selection']) == 0: 
		lotEventInfo['itemId'] = None
		lotEventInfo['itemPath'] = None
		lotEventInfo['itemUnitId'] = None
	else:
		system.perspective.print("Setting itemId to %s"%payload['selection'][0]['value']['itemId'] if payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('itemId') else None)
		lotEventInfo['itemId'] = payload['selection'][0]['value']['itemId'] if payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('itemId') else None
		lotEventInfo['itemPath'] = payload['selection'][0]['value']['itemPath'] if payload['selection'][0]['value'].has_key('itemPath') else None

	self.view.custom.lotEventInfo = lotEventInfo
	
	return
